newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi prince suffers light injuries in crash.
newsitem.headline: Saudi prince suffers light injuries in crash.

text.p: Saudi Arabian billionaire Prince al-Waleed bin Talal escaped with light injuries from a car crash in the Saudi capital Riyadh, sources close to the prince said on Sunday.
They said the prince, 39, suffered bruises when his car was in collision with another vehicle on Friday.
Saudi newspapers on Sunday published messages from Saudi citizens and companies congratulating the prince on his escape.
The prince, a nephew of King Fahd, has built a multi-billion dollar business with worldwide interests in banking, property, construction, media, travel, supermarkets and other sectors.
His latest acquisition was the George V Hotel in Paris.
Last year he signed a deal with U.S. singer Michael Jackson setting up Kingdom Entertainment to cooperate on concerts, films, television, theme parks and hotels.

The prince heads the United Saudi Commercial Bank and has substantial investments in Citicorp, Euro Disney SCA, which owns a theme park near Paris, Canary Wharf in London's Docklands, U.S. retail group Saks Fifth Avenue, the Plaza Hotel in New York and the Four Seasons and Fairmont hotel chains.
